title.value: AN ACT to amend the environmental conservation law, in relation to prohibiting the sale and distribution of anti-fogging sprays or wipes containing perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances
title.provenance: AN ACT to amend the environmental conservation law, in relation to prohibiting the sale and distribution of anti-fogging sprays or wipes containing perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances

status.provenance: Introduced  by  M.  of  A.  GALLAGHER,  STERN, GONZALEZ-ROJAS, JACOBSON, LEVENBERG, SIMON, SIMONE, ROSENTHAL,  COLTON,  REYES,  SHIMSKY,  RAGA, CLARK,  SEAWRIGHT, FORREST, OTIS, BURDICK, MAMDANI, MEEKS -- read once and referred to the Committee on Environmental Conservation -- committee discharged, bill amended, ordered reprinted as amended and recommitted to said committee

pfas_definition.provenance: "Perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances" or "PFAS" means a class of fluorinated organic chemicals containing at least one fully fluorinated carbon atom.

type.provenance: no person that sells or offers for sale any anti-fogging sprays or wipes containing perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances

date.provenance: This act shall take effect immediately.

who.provenance: No person that sells or offers for sale any anti-fogging sprays or wipes

action.provenance: no person that sells or offers for sale any anti-fogging sprays or wipes

value: good faith reliance on written assurance of manufacturer
exceptions.provenance: if they can show that they relied in good faith on the written assurance of the manufacturer of such product that such product met the requirements of this section.

currently_unavoidable.provenance: No person that sells or offers for sale any anti-fogging sprays or wipes shall be held in violation of this section if they can show that they relied in good faith on the written assurance of the manufacturer of such product that such product met the requirements of this section.

intentionally_added.provenance: No person that sells or offers for sale any anti-fogging sprays or wipes containing perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances
